items.html: And behold, when ZA is in the pregnancy, in his mother's womb and complete in his limbs, then Aba and Ima couple in their external vessels, with the phase of their internal and surrounding Nefesh, as above, and beget the phase of Mochin for ZA, for the days of the pregnancy, and they are the secret of his Nefesh, and they become a first Tzelem, as mentioned, and they clothe in ZA, after the completion of the formation of the said Tzelem there, within the externality of the vessels of the said Tevuna, and enter within the vessels of ZA to give him life during the time of the pregnancy.
